exposure: Presence or absence of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
cohort: 2,223 pregnant women with histologically verified PAS disorders
finding: Placenta previa, previous endometritis, previous placenta removal, ART, and vaginal operative birth were found to be important risk factors for PPH in women with PAS disorders, independent of delivery mode.
mod_finding: Vaginal operative birth was associated with an increased risk of PPH in women with PAS disorders.
